status: Synthetic recovery-study design for SSOT §17 and TC-08d–g (task 62b). Every value in this file is a study-design choice and NOT a registered APGI value, except the entries listed under 'registered_values_used', which are copied from specification/parameters.json and checked against it by test_recovery_pipeline.py. The generating ranges of the composite gains k_C = η_θ·c₁, k_V = η_θ·v₁, k_C2 = η_θ·c₂, k_V2 = η_θ·v₂ and of δ_reset in the c2_reset block (per step at this dt) were chosen so that θ moves by O(0.1 AU); they are not estimates of anything. r_max is unregistered (B-13) and fixed here at 5/s.
observation: Every-step ignition events B(t) with known inputs (oracle observation). A behavioral report is a parameter-free garbling of B, so this bounds what behavior can identify from above.

allo_fast.question: Are τ_θ, k_C = η_θ·c₁ and k_V = η_θ·v₁ recovered from events when the stimulus changes fast relative to τ_θ?

allo_blocks.question: Does a slow block design (40 s on, 40 s off) separate adaptation (k) from recovery (τ_θ)?

ne.question: Are g_NE and γ_NE separately recovered when both NE pathways are active (EQ-NE-1 clamp included)?

sig.question: How much does a free precision scale Π̄ (both channels) cost the recovery of γ_sig, against Π̄ fixed numerically as §17 requires?

allo_c2v2.question: Are k_C2 = η_θ·c₂ (event cost) and k_V2 = η_θ·v₂ (interoceptive value) recovered from events, with τ_θ free and δ_reset known?

c2_reset.question: Are k_C2 = η_θ·c₂·B(t−1) and δ_reset·B(t) separable? Both raise θ by a fixed amount per event, one step apart.
